comparison.objective: Remove a tagged bin from the middle of a gravity-flow lane while controlling the following bin.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanually extract one bin while arresting gravity-driven motion, then release remaining bins to close the lane.
comparison.success_condition: Tagged bin placed in reject tote, next bin moved at most 2 cm before placement, remaining bins closed up and released.
comparison.reason: Tests dynamic queue control and bin extraction, with no fracture, precision mandrel alignment, or debris containment.
